description.value: Me Coffee&Tea (覓Me) is a bubble tea café situated in the busy Number 3 Road retail corridor in Richmond, a hub of the city's vibrant Chinese-Canadian food scene. The shop offers takeaway service, positioning it as a quick hydration stop for cyclists moving through Richmond's commercial centre. Its Chinese-language name and bubble tea focus reflect the cultural character of the surrounding neighbourhood.

All amenity fields therefore rely solely on OSM tags. OSM confirms takeaway=yes and cuisine=bubble_tea; no other amenity-relevant tags are present.
